title: DOW-UAP-D087, U.S. Air Force Analysis of Flying Objects in the United States, 1-100
doc_notes: This document is a U.S. Air Force analysis of unidentified flying objects containing multiple reports of close-range encounters and physical observations.

encounters.summary: Three objects observed in formation, described as spherical or disc-like, performing maneuvers.
encounters.quote: all three stated that the objects were not weather balloons

encounters.summary: Test pilot observed a yellow-amber object, 5-10 feet in diameter, performing forward whirling movements.
encounters.quote: noticed a disc-like object with a forward whirling movement

encounters.summary: Witnesses observed a black metallic object, cigar-shaped, hovering and then moving.
Control tower operator observed a glowing object with a tail that changed color from amber to red.
Pilot and crew observed a bright object performing maneuvers, described as having no control surfaces.
encounters.quote: radically built and power - possibly atomic

encounters.summary: Witnesses observed a green, soccer-ball-shaped object that appeared to dip toward the ground.
encounters.quote: green coloured object... shape and size of a soccer ball

encounters.summary: Witnesses observed a fire-colored, round object with a tail that appeared to spin.
